podcast.body: The debut record by Our Lady Peace featured "Starseed" as its first single, released in May 1994. This marked an early moment in what would become a significant era for Canadian rock music. "Originally released in May 1994 as the first single off their debut record, Art Lady Peace and Star Seed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Roots of the 90s CanRock Explosion

podcast.body: This debut album featured a re-recorded version of the song "Super Satellite," which had previously appeared on the band's early demo. "This is an early version of a song that eventually appeared on RLAD Peace's debut album, Naveed."
